name: dropshipping-store
description: Workspace orchestrating Openfront (commerce), OpenShip (fulfillment routing), and the custom storefront. See DROPSHIPPING-AGENT-PLAN.md.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:openfront && npm run setup:openship && npm run setup:storefront
scripts.dev:openship: cd openship && cross-env PORT=3001 npm run dev
scripts.dev:storefront: cd openfront-storefront && cross-env PORT=3002 npm run dev
